items.route: Inspect saved metadata leads, aliases, search remainder and cross-language implementations before excluding any candidate.
Build a pinned, rights-reviewed minimal Java reference; evaluate metric methods and splits at equal probabilities and boundary support. Resolve source/document mismatch before KL-path admission.
Trace priorClassDist, missing-feature branches, superclass serialization and threshold keys; qualify full engine/MOJO equivalence, treatment/category maps and unsupported groups.
Inspect matrix exception types, legal-graph helpers and cache identity; test signed/absolute minima, ties, singular covariances and category/column permutations.
Acquire and inspect genuine PDFs named in upstream headers before attributing theorem or formal error-control claims; this review relies on source behavior only.
Register independent unit/cluster/time sampling laws and held-out mechanisms; establish coverage and policy value before any deployment decision.
Freeze source revision, JVM, build, complete artifacts, dependencies and notices; process boundaries do not themselves resolve licensing.
